association: a true object takes the nearest confirmed track of an established kind (mover, static, line) within the gallery's gate (gate_m), else the nearest of any kind within it; each track is compared with the object moved by its velocity to the time the track's state holds, its last detection's reflection time, transmit + R/c (D-156; gallery.object_track, state_time): an extended object (several points, a hull, a boat, a small box) by the distance from its outline (the convex hull of its footprint; 0 inside), ties by the distance from its centre, a point object by the distance from its centre (D-157; gallery._miss). error_m is from the outline, centroid_error_m from the centre (the score before D-157). A false mover is a mover whose class position at the last ping (classify_tracks time = t_last) is no closer than the gate to every moving object's outline at the last ping (gallery.classify_and_score, count_false_movers). Tracks are classified through their measured positions where the capture recorded them (D-157)
